pa-adaptation-notes.txt:
PA policy coding from bill summaries: choose the substantive issue named in the summary; a codebook heading or statute title alone need not determine the code. Purchased examples and verified codebook rules:
- Public School Code amendment on written agreements between districts -> 602, elementary/secondary education. Code 602 covers regulation, creation, and operation of school districts and boards, as well as general school funding and governance.
- Title 42 Judiciary and Judicial Procedure amendment authorizing freezing defendants' assets in certain cases -> 1204, court administration/procedure. Code 1204 covers state court procedures and legal processes even when the matter is criminal.
- Host municipality agreements and moratorium for municipal and residual waste facilities -> 703, nonhazardous waste disposal. Code 703 covers municipal solid waste management and waste facilities; the host municipality angle does not shift this to local government. Reserve 704 for hazardous waste/toxic chemicals.
- Title 18 Crimes and Offenses amendment defining racketeering activity -> 1202, white collar/organized crime. Code 1202 explicitly covers racketeering control; do not assign a generic crime code solely from the Title 18 citation.
Related codebook distinctions: 1203 covers illegal drug trafficking and drug-related property seizure; 1204 covers judicial administration, court procedures, and legal services; 602 is general elementary/secondary education, whereas 603 is disadvantaged students, 606 special education, and 607 standards/testing or subject excellence. These are general codebook distinctions, not additional gold examples.
